provenance.source: Jayah, T.H., Aye, L., Fuller, R.J., Stewart, D.F. (2003). Biomass and Bioenergy 25(5), 459-469
provenance.description: Table 5: predicted (Jayah model) and measured dry gas composition for 2.5 cm chips. The text of Section 7 identifies this as Run No. 7; the measured values are identical to Run 7 in Table 3.

operating_conditions.note: AFR and moisture taken from Run 7 (Table 3) because the paper identifies Table 5 as Run 7; chip size 2.5 cm as stated in the Table 5 caption (Table 3 lists Run 7 as 5.5 cm - an inconsistency in the paper). Dry feed rate 18.6 kg/h from Table 4 (assumed).

CH4.note: Assumed in Jayah's model; imposed (1.2 % at throat) in this model as well - not a prediction
